ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton recall codes
ResearchProjectDef.description: Fragments of the old empire's command codes still drift through the mechband. Pieced together and broadcast from a modified mechband antenna, they wake the skeleton legions that went dormant when the empire fell.\n\nWhatever answers has been alone in the dark for a very long time. Its protocols are corrupted and it will attack anything it finds, but a skeleton brought down intact can be interrogated and reprogrammed to serve the colony.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton repair kits
ResearchProjectDef.description: Work out how the ancient skeleton frames were patched up in the field, and make repair kits for them. Skeletons do not heal on their own; a crafter with a repair kit can work on a damaged skeleton until it is whole.

ResearchProjectDef.label: skeleton repair beds
ResearchProjectDef.description: Rebuild the repair cradles the old empire kept for its skeletons. A powered repair bed slowly mends a skeleton lying in it, scars included. Its control system needs an AI persona core.
